description:
Updates a custom field.

**[Permissions](#permissions) required:** *Administer Jira* [global permission](https://confluence.atlassian.com/x/x4dKLg).

parameters.description: The ID of the custom field.
parameters.name: fieldId

example.description: Select the manager and the corresponding employee.
example.name: Managers and employees list

204.description: Returned if the request is successful.

application/json.example: {"errorMessages":["searcherKey is invalid for the field type."],"errors":{}}

400.description: Returned if the request is not valid.

401.description: Returned if the authentication credentials are incorrect or missing.

application/json.example: {"errorMessages":["Only Jira administrators can edit custom fields."],"errors":{}}

403.description: Returned if the user does not have the required permissions.

404.description: Returned if the custom field is not found.
